name: AgentSEO
tagline: SEO and AI search research tools for developers and AI agents
description: AgentSEO is a freemium SEO intelligence platform with a REST API and hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for developers and AI agents. It provides Google SERP analysis, keyword research, competitor and backlink data, rank tracking, local SEO checks, content gap analysis, and Google AI Overview research for answer engine optimization (AEO). Tool execution requires an AgentSEO account, API key, and usage credits.
